archiveTitle: Evening Brief | Persona 4 Revival producer discusses remake direction

entries.headline: Persona 4 Revival producer discusses remake direction: updated visuals and gameplay, series philosophy unchanged
entries.summary: ATLUS Persona team general producer Kazuhisa Wada spoke on the Official Xbox Podcast about Persona 4 Revival and the series' 30th anniversary. He said the team now develops with simultaneous global release in mind, placing greater emphasis on localization, quality assurance, and overall development structure. The program also explicitly stated that the remake will update visuals and gameplay.
entries.verification: Official Xbox Wire podcast transcript checked; the speaker's identity, series 30th anniversary, global simultaneous release approach, and the remake's updated visuals and gameplay all come from primary content.

entries.headline: RPG Maker U2U shifts development direction: becomes standalone app, no longer relies on Unity
entries.summary: Gotcha Gotcha Games has published the Steam page for RPG Maker U2U and explained that the development policy has been adjusted: the product will no longer be provided as running on Unity, but will be released as a standalone application like RPG Maker MV and MZ. The new title will retain the P2D map feature and continue the familiar event, database, and battle setup workflow.

entries.headline: CONQUISTA: Tide of Wills announced; citizens' 'wills' drive national change
entries.summary: Shueisha Games has announced CONQUISTA: Tide of Wills, developed by Micro Simulation, planned for PC in summer 2027. The game combines 4X strategy with colony simulation; each citizen has a name, job, and life, and their wishes and frustrations form 'passions' that drive national change, even directly affecting the lord's governance.

entries.headline: Co-op heist sandbox Dumpster Gang announced; up to 4 raccoons team up to 'clean out' human homes
entries.summary: Curve Games has announced Dumpster Gang, developed by Coyote House Games, planned for PC this December and coming to PC Game Pass. Players control raccoons sneaking into homes to steal items, playable solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op. As the heists escalate, players must avoid staff shooing raccoons away, and teammates caught in cages can be rescued by allies.

entries.headline: Chronoscript: The Endless End playable at gamescom; 2D manuscript maze and 3D mansion intertwine
entries.summary: AUTOMATON played Chronoscript: The Endless End on-site at gamescom. The game traps an editor inside a manuscript world written by a vampire, with 2D Metroidvania-style mazes as the main exploration space, while 3D presents the mansion outside the manuscript. This is the first public playable demo at the Shueisha Games booth.
